title: Credential Renewal DAG
details: Automate renewal workflow with nodes for evidence intake, VC regeneration, signature, anchor submission, and provider notification.

title: Revocation Propagation Engine
details: Update revocation status-list bits, notify issuers, notify providers via push, and update employer FitScore consistency.

title: Revocation Visibility UI
details: Show revocation timeline, reasoning, related PSV evidence, and chain anchor on issuer portal.

title: Cross-Chain Public Verification API
details: Expose public verification endpoint returning anchor proofs with Ethereum/Polygon contract state validation.

title: Public Verify Page
details: Standalone public webpage for employers to verify a VC hash with anchor proofs.

title: Cross-Org Privilege Transport
details: When provider moves orgs, transport privileges with policy-based filtering and re-evaluation triggers.

title: Cross-Org Transition UI
details: Provider sees privileges that transfer, ones that require renewal, and ones that sunset.

title: Delegated Issuance Workflow
details: Add issuance approval chain: dept head → admin → chain anchoring; capture signatures and timestamps.

title: Delegation Approvals UI
details: Show delegated roles, pending approvals, expiration of delegated powers.

title: Employment Verification Engine
details: Allow employers to verify past roles, privileges, and training with time-bound VC packages.

title: Employment History View
details: Providers see anchored employment history including facility, role, privileges granted.

title: Continuous Credential Monitoring
details: Evaluate credential statuses every 24 hours; detect pending expirations, mismatch, drift, sanctions.

title: Compliance Heat Index View
details: Display risk across department/provider populations with red/yellow/green compliance indicators.

title: Fraud Probability Engine
details: Compute fraud likelihood using anomalies, chain inconsistencies, rapid VC churn, mismatch patterns.

title: Fraud Probability UI
details: Compliance screen with risk score, reasoning, suspicious evidence events.

title: PSV Failure Recovery
details: Auto-correct PSV failures via fallback data sources, notify issuers, allow override flow.

title: Clinician Mobility Forecast
details: Predict interstate mobility readiness and suggest next steps for broader eligibility.

title: Mobility Forecast UI
details: Providers see a map visualization showing where they can soon practice.

title: ATS Hiring Feedback Loop
details: Collect employer hiring outcomes to refine FitScore, IntentScore, MatchScore.

title: FitScore Reinforcement Model
details: Improve FitScore using actual job placement success metrics.

title: Hiring Outcome Dashboard
details: Shows relevancy of applicants, pipeline efficiency, hiring confidence metrics.

title: VC Custody Tracking
details: Track every credential’s lifecycle: issued→picked up→presented→verified→revoked. Anchor custody nodes to chain.

title: Custody Timeline UI
details: Issuer sees custody chain, anchor references, verification history.

title: Cross-Platform Sync Engine
details: Ensure web, mobile, and employer portal sync provider states consistently via event streams + deltas.

title: Conflict Resolution Local Storage
details: Detect local → server mismatches and resolve by prompting user or force-syncing securely.

title: Shift Economy Insights
details: Employer UI showing cost-per-shift, credential ROI, staffing gaps.

title: Workforce Volatility Index
details: Track system-level volatility across expirations, sanctions, privileges, hiring bursts.

title: Surge Readiness Score
details: Quantify how ready a provider or facility is to meet sudden demand surges.

title: Surge Readiness Dashboard
details: Exec-level model output: where staffing is most at risk or easily strengthened.

title: Credential Evidence Exporter
details: Generate downloadable bundles for audits, onboarding partners, or contracting reviews.

title: Evidence Export UI
details: UI for issuers to generate export bundles.

title: Org Workforce Simulation
details: Simulate staffing scenarios: What happens if 20 licenses expire? If sanctions spike? If hiring slows?

title: Simulation Console
details: Admins run simulations, compare outcomes, export results.

title: Historical Dataset Builder
details: Construct anonymized datasets for analytics: hires, failures, credential patterns, privileges.

title: Credential Cost Model
details: Estimate credential cost-per-hire, ROI of renewal strategies, and employer savings.

title: ROI Dashboard
details: Show financial benefit of VitalCV adoption for employers.

title: Multilingual Support Infrastructure
details: Implement i18n for APIs; return localized labels for credential types, statuses, evidence, privilege categories.

title: Mobile Localization
details: Provider wallet translated into EN, ES, FR, Tagalog, Chinese.

title: Issuer Localization
details: Localized metadata for credentials, privileges, sanctions, org policies.

title: System Health Router
details: Aggregate DB, chain, queue, PSV, and notification health into a unified readiness endpoint.

title: System Health Console
details: Admin UI showing real-time health of the entire VitalCV infrastructure.

title: Provider Career Graph Builder
details: Construct graph of provider’s training, experience, privileges, employment, and outcomes.

title: Career Arc Predictor
details: Predict provider future roles, specialties, or leadership readiness.

title: Career Arc UI
details: Providers view predicted career pathways and recommended steps.

title: VC Pack Issuance Engine
details: Issue credential packs for 'Hospitalist Pack', 'Telehealth Pack', 'Surge Pack' from templates.

title: VC Pack Designer
details: Issuer UI for constructing reusable VC packs.

title: ATS Apply Feedback API
details: Return structured employer hiring feedback to refine FitScores and recommendations.

title: Apply Feedback Viewer
details: Provider sees reasons why an application succeeded or failed.

title: Lifecycle Snapshot Engine
details: Store snapshots of provider lifecycle state for audit and compliance trend analysis.

title: Final Full-System Golden Path
details: Test full system under realistic conditions: chain load, PSV outages, multi-org workflows, ATS flows, surge detection, privilege checks, and job application loops.
